headline: TEX @ KCR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TEX 3.97 at KCR 3.12, with a projected total of 7.09. Batter research is strongest for Josh Jung, Vinnie Pasquantino, Jac Caglianone, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Justin Foscue because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
